National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No. 02 of 1974
Order under Section 92

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No. 02 of 1974, I, Jeevan Thondaman, Minister of Water Supply and Estate Infrastructure Development, published an announcement on page 1A and 2A under No. 01-0042 in the Government Extraordinary Gazette No. 2261/33 dated 05.01.2022 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka in extent of the land mentioned as 25 perches which I hereby declare should be amended to read the extent of the same as ''11 perches" and boundaries of the land should be amended as follows:
Lot 'A' of the Advance Tracing No. Maha/PSK/2023/129
North by : Lot No. 82 of the Preliminary Plan A 1120;East by : Lot No. 82 of the Preliminary Plan A 1120;
